sc: Acolyte's diary page is a page of Elei's Diary which can be found in the Temple of Aminishi in either normal or story mode.
To obtain this item, players must partake in smithing a ceremonial sword after randomly being given plans when they finish smithing an item in the Artisans' Workshop.
Although only members can smith this sword and it is untradeable, the wield option and the stats are available in free-to-play servers.

sc: The crystal tinderbox is a degradable tinderbox made by singing a crystal tool seed with 150 harmonic dust, requiring 80 Smithing and giving 300 Smithing experience.
When it spawns a fire spirit, it loses 3.

Additionally, these bones may be obtained when looting a zombie impling jar.
Dark Mage's cape is a back slot cosmetic override that can be purchased for 4 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 48 of the Yak to Basics event with the premier pass.
It is a 1/500 drop from hunting diseased jadinkos.
It is also obtainable from training at one of the skilling stations in the Dream of Iaia.
Although its examine text says, 'Looks to be mainly made from coal', it cannot be used in place of coal when smelting ores.

Elite Mammoth Legs.x: The Elite Mammoth Legs are a legs slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Elite Mammoth outfit.

Elven Legs.x: The Elven Legs are a legs slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Elven outfit. They are the override equivalent of the Elf-style trousers and Elf-style skirt items.

It was originally unlocked by completing tier 31 of Zodiyak Track with the premier pass.

Falador shield 1.x: The Falador shield 1 is a small buckler shield achieved by completing the Easy Falador achievements. If you lose your shield you can get another by talking to Redbeard Frank in Port Sarim, easily reached using the explorer's ring 3.

sc: Fallen leaves are the components of the Coronet of Autumn, and are won through playing Squeal of Fortune, or awarded while Farming.

Fatebound Champion Legpiece.x: The Fatebound Champion Legpiece is a legs slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Fatebound Champion Armour set.

sc: The festive aura is a special aura that could be obtained by members during December every year since 2012.
If both the bank and inventory were full, players could talk to Xuan to obtain the aura manually.
To get the full 300% bonus, the player must have bonus experience already available in whatever skill they are training outside of the aura.
A blue Firemaking tome is an experience reward from the minigame, Temple Trekking.

The plans can be purchased from Sydekix's Shop of Balance for 2,500 Crux Eqal favour, unlocking the ability directly without giving the plans as an item to the player.

It is found in the second section, taken from a lectern with a tablet, and it must be taken to the other lectern in the southwest corner of the room, past a variety of traps.

sc: A phylactery is an item dropped by The Magister, which can be shattered to receive 5, 10, 15, or 25 scraps of scripture.
Thus, at least 12, at most 60, and on average 30 phylacteries are required to obtain enough scraps of scripture to craft a khopesh of Tumeken or a khopesh of Elidinis.

Templar Helm.x: The Templar Helm is a head slot cosmetic override that can be obtained by looting the coffins in the Tomb of the Fallen after completing The Death of Chivalry.

sc: Toffee apples were a food that could be obtained from the Scream of Fortune promotion from the Squeal of Fortune.
They came back in the 2014 Halloween event, as a possible reward from loot chests.
It can be crafted at level 96 Crafting, using 3 Tyrannomastyx hide, a thread, and a needle for 284.
Players can obtain it by exchanging discs with either Oaknock's exchanger or Yewnock's exchanger.
